record_id.description: Extract the record identifier from the source filename. It typically appears as the token 'TCELL' or 'TCLA' with a number immediately before or after it, e.g. '0001TCELL', 'TCELL123', 'TCLA-45', '45_TCLA'; or as a numeric code of the form NN-NNN, e.g. '12-123'. Return it exactly as it appears, preserving digits, letters and separators. If none is present, return an empty string.

EBER.description: EBER (EBER-ISH / EBER1-EBER2 in-situ hybridization). 0 is negative, 1 is positive, 2 is not done (not tested or not mentioned).

EBV_LMP.description: EBV-LMP (LMP1 / LMP2A, Latent Membrane Protein). 0 is negative, 1 is positive, 2 is not done (not tested or not mentioned).

EBNA.description: EBNA (EBNA1 / EBNA2, Epstein-Barr Nuclear Antigen). 0 is negative, 1 is positive, 2 is not done (not tested or not mentioned).

additional_markers.description: Any OTHER EBV marker mentioned in the report that is not EBER, EBV-LMP or EBNA above — one object per marker. Examples: BZLF1/ZEBRA/Zta, BMRF1/EA-D, VCA. For each, set `marker` to the marker name exactly as written in the report and `value` to its coded result. Only include a marker if the report actually mentions it. Do not invent markers, and do not repeat EBER, EBV-LMP or EBNA here.

marker.description: The EBV marker name exactly as it appears in the report, e.g. 'ZEBRA', 'EA-D', 'VCA'.

value.description: Coded result: 0 is negative, 1 is positive, 2 is not done.
